## Overview

Detect AI-generated comments and posts on Reddit

Slop Goggles helps you spot likely AI-generated posts and comments on Reddit so you can filter through the AI noise. If you've ever felt excited about a comment, started reading and even wrote a thoughtful response, but then got left with that nagging feeling of whether you just responded to a bot or not, Slop Goggles is built for exactly that moment. The extension analyzes Reddit content and highlights text that appears to be AI slop, helping you decide what deserves your attention. What Slop Goggles does: - Detects likely AI-generated Reddit posts and comments - Marks suspicious content directly in your Reddit feed and threads - Helps you filter low-value, repetitive, and promotional AI responses - Makes discussions easier to scan so you can focus on genuine human input Why use it: AI content is getting better, but a lot of it is still generic, repetitive, or engagement bait. Slop Goggles gives you an extra layer of awareness while reading so you can spend less time on noise and more time on useful conversations. Current support: - Reddit (more websites may be added in the future) Put on your Slop Goggles 🕶️ and filter out the AI noise!

A browser extension that uses machine learning to detect AI-generated comments on Reddit. Built with 🤗 Transformers.js for client-side inference.

This extension analyzes Reddit comments in real-time to identify content that may have been generated by Large Language Models (AI). It provides:

- **🚨 Visual highlighting** of potentially AI-generated comments
- **📊 User scoring system** that tracks AI detection percentages for individual users 
- **🎨 Color-coded risk levels** (green/orange/red based on AI percentage)
- **💾 Persistent tracking** across browsing sessions
- **⚡ Real-time analysis** as you browse Reddit
- **🎛️ Customizable aggression levels** from passive highlighting to auto-minimizing AI comments

Redd-Eye (Reddit AI & Bot Detection) – Get this Extension for 🦊 Firefox (en-US)

Redd Eye: AI and Bot DetectionRedd Eye is an open source extension created to flag suspected bot accounts and AI generated content on Reddit in real time. Whether you use the modern layout or old reddit, it integrates right into your feed to help you spot inauthentic activity at a glance.Key Features

- Real Time Detection: Scan and flag AI text and bot like behavior as you scroll through threads and comments.
- Visual Indicators: It uses color coded outlines and quick popups so you can instantly spot suspicious activity right on the page.
- Customizable Thresholds: You have full control. You can fine tune the sensitivity of both the AI and Bot detection algorithms to match your preferences using the built in sliders.
- Adjustable UI: Move the settings widget to any corner of your screen so it never blocks your browsing.
- Seamless Compatibility: It works across both the standard reddit interface and old reddit.

Privacy FirstYour data belongs to you. Redd Eye operates entirely locally on your machine. There is absolutely zero data collection, zero telemetry, and no hidden subscriptions. Your browsing history stays exactly where it belongs.Open Source and TransparentI built this project for transparency and trust.
